name: young-cohorts-only
about: §4R L2: a young account — every cohort is younger than 28 days, so the sheet holds counts and no rates at all.

output.headline: On 2026-11-03, Regional Class A — Joliet was the only campaign running and brought in 3 leads at $25.00 each.
points: Regional Class A — Joliet spent $75.00 to reach 3,900 impressions and 48 clicks, with a click rate of 1.2%.
Month-to-date spend on Meta stands at $225.00, with 28 days left in 2026-11.
The week-of-2026-10-19 cohort has 9 leads: 8 contacted, 4 converted to applicants, 2 applied, 1 hired, and none lost after conversion — but it is still young, so no rates are available yet.
The week-of-2026-10-26 cohort has 14 leads: 10 contacted, 3 converted to applicants, 1 applied, no hires, and 2 lost after conversion — also too young to judge by rates.
Qualified leads and leads lost before becoming applicants are not recorded in the system.
